# Known finding-set diffs between guff and golangci-lint (R21).
# Format: <target> <guff-only|golangci-only> <normalized-key>
# normalized-key = relpath:line:linter:message
# Regenerated by: ./compat/run.sh --update-allowlist
#
# Prefer fixing guff over growing this list. Entries here are accepted
# mismatches (message phrasing, enable-set gaps, known DEFERRED).
#
# WARNING: `--update-allowlist` rewrites this file from the current diff and
# drops the comments below. The rationale for every entry is kept in
# docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §5, which is the copy to read and to update.
#
# Keys are pinned to telegraf v1.39.3 (corpus/hunt.json), so the line numbers
# are stable until that ref moves.
#
# revive time-equal x3 — §6's standing decision, "do not follow revive's
# importer blindness". Same mechanism as the jaeger rows, and the same as the
# `time-naming` / `epoch-naming` / `time-equal` rows the `cases/revive` ratchet
# already carries.
#
# `time-equal` needs types, and revive type-checks its *own* files:
#
#     w := &lintTimeEqual{file, onFailure}
#     if w.file.Pkg.TypeCheck() != nil {
#         return nil
#     }
#
# `lint.Package.TypeCheck` uses `types.Config{Importer: importer.Default()}`,
# which since Go 1.20 reaches stdlib export data by running
# `$build.Default.GOROOT/bin/go list -export`. golangci-lint means to point
# `build.Default.GOROOT` at the real toolchain, but reads the value through
# `func (e Env) Discover(...)` (pkg/goutil/env.go) — a **value receiver** that
# assigns the discovered map to its own copy — so `Env.Get(GOROOT)` returns ""
# and `build.Default.GOROOT` keeps whatever was baked into the binary at *its*
# build time. On this host that is the Homebrew golangci-lint built against
# go1.26.2, and the toolchain has since moved to 1.26.5, so the path is gone.
# The whole rule then returns nil and the package reports nothing.
#
# Measured 2026-09-05 (docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §4, 続き 190) in a two-function
# scratch module, each run with a fresh `GOLANGCI_LINT_CACHE`:
#
#     plain                     unconditional-recursion only
#     GOROOT=$(go env GOROOT)   + both time-equal rows, identical to guff
#
# guff type-checks the package it was given, so it always sees `time.Time`.
# That is the behaviour to keep; the environment is what differs.
telegraf guff-only plugins/inputs/vsphere/endpoint.go:1200:revive:time-equal: use roundedTS.Equal(lastBucket) instead of "==" operator
telegraf guff-only plugins/outputs/logzio/logzio_test.go:118:revive:time-equal: use !lm.Time.Equal(tm.Time()) instead of "!=" operator
telegraf guff-only plugins/processors/dedup/dedup.go:56:revive:time-equal: use metric.Time().Equal(m.Time()) instead of "==" operator
